statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds an entry with vendorProject VMware and a product containing vCenter, with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-30.
resolution: The public CISA KEV JSON feed, fetched on the deadline, contains at least one entry meeting those vendor, product, and dateAdded criteria.
failure_condition: No KEV entry for a VMware vCenter vulnerability carries a dateAdded value inside the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-15 and 2026-10-15, Shell publicly confirms that data was stolen from it or a direct supplier in the incident tied to Clop theft claims.
resolution: A Shell statement or regulatory filing confirming data theft, issued within the window and reported by at least two of Reuters, BleepingComputer, or the Financial Times.
failure_condition: Shell issues no confirmation of data theft connected to the Clop claims by the end of the window.

statement: Between 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-30, the armed forces or defence ministry of a NATO member state officially reports intercepting or shooting down a drone inside its national airspace.
resolution: An official statement by a NATO member defence ministry or armed forces confirming an intercept or downing in the window, carried by two named international wire or broadsheet outlets.
failure_condition: No NATO member government officially confirms a drone intercept or downing in its airspace during the window.

statement: Jared Kushner meets Benjamin Netanyahu in person in Israel between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: Two of Reuters, AP, Al Jazeera, or Times of Israel report that the meeting took place in Israel within the window.
failure_condition: The two men do not meet in Israel within the window, whether the visit is cancelled, delayed past 2026-08-31, or relocated.

statement: The Electoral Commission of Zambia officially declares a winner of the presidential election between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-31.
resolution: An official ECZ declaration of a president-elect within the window, reported by two of Reuters, AP, BBC, or AFP.
failure_condition: Suspended counting or litigation prevents any official ECZ declaration of a winner before the window closes.

statement: A guilty plea by Luigi Mangione is entered on the court record in his federal or New York state case between 2026-08-14 and 2026-10-30.
resolution: The SDNY or New York state court docket records entry of a guilty plea within the window.
failure_condition: No guilty plea is entered on either docket within the window, including if plea talks collapse or the case proceeds toward trial.

statement: The S&P 500 index closes below 7000 on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2027-01-29.
resolution: Official S&P Dow Jones Indices closing values show at least one close below 7000.00 within the window.
failure_condition: Every official S&P 500 close in the window is at or above 7000.00.

statement: ICE Brent front-month crude settles at or above 100.00 dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Official ICE Brent front-month settlement prices show at least one settlement at or above 100.00 within the window.
failure_condition: Every ICE Brent front-month settlement in the window is below 100.00.

statement: The USGS ComCat catalog records at least one earthquake of magnitude 6.0 or greater with epicenter within 300 km of USGS event us6000tjl2 and origin time between 2026-08-15 and 2026-09-14.
resolution: A ComCat query on the deadline returns at least one M 6.0 or greater event meeting the distance and origin-time criteria.
failure_condition: ComCat contains no qualifying M 6.0 or greater event within 300 km for the stated origin window.

statement: The WHO Director-General declares the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern between 2026-08-15 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: A WHO announcement of a PHEIC determination for the DRC Ebola outbreak, published on who.int within the window.
failure_condition: WHO makes no PHEIC determination for this outbreak within the window, regardless of case counts or committee meetings.
